Functional description

All the electrical equipment and systems are supplied by the battery A1 .

The main supply lines are protected by the MAXIFUSE box B5 which contains the fuses named according to the circuits protected:

  • IGN: ignition switch H1 supply;
  • J/B2 and J/B1: supply for services through junction unit B1 fuses.

Functional description

  • EFI: supply for fuses and relays for engine management

Functional description

  • UGD: supply for fuses and relays for engine management

Functional description

Other MAXIFUSE fuses are located individually in the engine compartment and protect the following systems:

  • B7 ABS supply;
  • B8 engine cooling fan supply;

Functional description

Other bridge fuses are located in the compartment on the dashboard, driver's side, next to the junction unit B1 ; others are located in the relay and fuse unit in the engine compartment.

Other circuits are supplied by turning ignition key H1 to various different positions:

  • in the ON position, numerous circuits and services controlled by the ignition (INT line) are supplied, protected by fuses for the junction unit B1 and (line 15/54) by bridge fuses B25, B26 and B31;
  • in the ON position - the starter motor is supplied; (line '50') (E5010);
  • In this position several circuits are disconnected (line 'INT/A'). protected by shunt fuse B27 ;
  • in the PARK position the side lights are supplied ('STAZ' and 'POS' lines); (E2010).
